mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees with overcast conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School and a new moon in the sky.
The city has published notices regarding upcoming primary and general elections, plus work begins on August 18 for highway improvements on Highway M with expected lane shifts.
There is plenty happening today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia nights at the Mill and the Bogey Factory.
On August 6, an officer arrested a man for his fourth O W I offence after observing him driving erratically on the road.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, but since the store is currently closed, keep in mind they open at 10 AM. Tomorrow's featured flavor will be Devil's Food Cake.
